title: EventBus selective unregister and owner re-registration broadcast contract

contract.selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the targeted owner registration
contract.owner_reregistration: A previously unregistered owner can register the callback again successfully
contract.reregistration_uniqueness: Re-registration creates exactly one listener entry for the owner
contract.cross_owner_broadcast: An emitted event is delivered to all currently registered listeners for the event name regardless of owner
contract.delivery_once: Each currently registered listener receives the emitted event exactly once
contract.source_metadata: The event source preserves the plugin_id supplied to emit()
contract.registry_preservation: Broadcast delivery does not alter the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
